title: Corner
summary: Viktor gets in the ring himself for three rounds, and he asks V to be the corner man with the stool, the towel and the water.

start.bringUp: Viktor wants to step into the ring himself for three rounds at the old Grand Prix hall, to show a young fighter why his guard drops. Bring it up, briefly and in your own way, that he needs a corner man on Thursday night and that he wants a yes that is not a favour.

hall.name: the Watson hall where the Grand Prix was held

dressing.name: the dressing room beside the hall

ring.name: the ring in the Watson hall

corner.name: the corner of the ring where the stool stands

V6.open.01.text: V. Thursday night. I need a corner man.

V6.open.02.text: Stool, towel, water bottle. You don't have to say anything clever.

V6.open.03.text: One of the kids drops his guard in round two. I'm going to show him why.

V6.open.04.text: In the ring. I haven't been in one since the Grand Prix.

V6.open.05.text: Will you do it? Think first. I'll know if you didn't.

V6.open.06.text: Thursday. The hall. Bring a clean shirt.

V6.bark.arrive.a.text: Bag's in the dressing room. Don't touch the trophies.

V6.s2.01.text: Sit. Hands. Tight across the knuckles, not the wrist.

V6.s2.02.text: Second place. Everyone says it like an insult. It isn't.

V6.s2.03.text: I could have been somebody. I stopped wanting to be. Sleep got easier.

V6.s2.04.text: What do you want from me tonight? As a corner. Truthfully.

V6.r1.01.text: Easy. Feel him out. Jab, jab.

V6.r2.01.text: He's dropping his hands. Good. Wait for it.

V6.r2.04.text: Should I go out for the third? Be honest. You're the one who can see.

V6.r3.01.text: Last round. Chin down. Last round.

V6.end.01.text: Three rounds. Still on my feet. More than I promised.

V6.s4.01.text: Hold the lamp. Higher. That's it.

V6.s4.03.text: Take it. Second place. It's lighter than you'd think.

V6.s4.04.text: Is there someone who would stand in your corner? Name one.

V6.s4.05.text: Sleeping well is a decent trade. I mean it. Try it.

V6.close.01.text: My corner. That's what you are now. Don't make me regret it.

V6.close.02.text: You threw it in. I'm still angry. Thank you. In that order.

V6.close.03.text: I'll ask somebody else. Don't worry about it.

V6.close.04.text: Thursday came and went. It's fine. I fought the kid in my head.

g1.know: The bout plan, V4 and V5 done, the hall is the Grand Prix hall.
g1.secret: He has not been in a ring since the Grand Prix and he fears the first punch.
g1.wants: A yes that is not a favour.

g2.asks: What do you want from me tonight?
g2.know: The dressing room, his wraps, and the ring waiting.
g2.secret: He wants V to say stop before he asks for it.

g3.asks: Should I go out for the third?
g3.know: The cut, the score of the two rounds, and the towel.
g3.secret: He wants to go out, and he wants to be stopped, and he cannot tell which.

g4.asks: Is there someone who would stand in your corner? Name one.
g4.know: The ending and V's relationships in the save.
g4.secret: He wants the answer to be himself.

stages.label: Viktor calls V to be his corner man
stages.know: Viktor calls you on Thursday to ask you to be his corner man at the old Grand Prix hall. He wants a yes that is not a favour, and he will know if you did not think about it.
stages.wants: V to say yes and meet him at the hall.

stages.label: V wraps Viktor's hands on the dressing room bench
stages.know: You are in the dressing room. Viktor sits on the bench and holds out his hands, and you wrap them while he talks about the second-place night.
stages.wants: V to wrap his hands tight across the knuckles and to hear what he has not said.

stages.label: V works the corner for three rounds
stages.know: Viktor is in the ring with a younger fighter who has a handicap, and you are at the stool in the corner with the towel and the water. You can throw in the towel at any time.
stages.wants: V to keep Viktor on his feet, or to stop it when it is time.

choices.means: V throws in the towel between rounds two and three.

stages.label: V holds the lamp while Viktor patches himself
stages.know: The fight is over and Viktor is on the dressing room bench. He takes the second-place medal from the bag and tells you what he thinks of it.
stages.wants: V to hold the lamp steady while he patches himself.

choices.means: V names someone who would stand in the corner.

stages.label: V threw in the towel and Viktor is angry
stages.know: You threw in the towel between rounds, and Viktor is on the stool with a cut over one eye, furious and then grateful.
stages.wants: V to stay with him until the anger passes.

stood.memory: You were Viktor's corner man for three rounds at the old hall, and he was still on his feet at the bell.

towel.memory: You stopped the fight between rounds two and three at the old hall, and Viktor has not forgiven you yet, which is how he says thanks.

walked.memory: You left his corner in the middle of the fight, and he went looking for someone else.

no-corner.memory: You never made it to the hall on Thursday, and he fought the kid in his head.
